text.tspan: Running total = number of items <= value

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Key Positioning Rule: The running total count[v] gives the 1-based end position.
In a 0-based array, value v is placed at index count[v] - 1, then count[v] is decremented.

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Counting sort avoids pairwise comparisons by indexing counts directly into memory.
Works best when the key range k is small: Theta(n + k) time and Theta(n + k) space.

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: The running total tells where each value belongs in the output list.
